title: Among the cards with converted mana cost higher than 5 in the set Coldsnap,
question:
Among the cards with converted mana cost higher than 5 in the set Coldsnap, how many of them have unknown power?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; converted mana cost higher than 5 refers to convertedManaCost > 5; unknown power refers to power = '*' or T1.power is null

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.XCL_012 = s.XCL_099
WHERE s.XCL_108 = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.XCL_011 > 5
  AND (c.XCL_055 = '*' OR c.XCL_055 IS NULL)
